programs.title: Around China by Train Ep.1
programs.desc: This documentary follows Chinese and French hosts as they take six train routes across China, showcasing China’s urban culture and remarkable achievements along the way.

programs.title: Cities of the Future Ep.1
programs.desc: This documentary turns its lens to the essential infrastructure of China’s cities, filming 35 hidden projects—including flood control and drainage, emergency response, and water, electricity, and gas supply. From the perspectives of urban renewal, industrial innovation, and dynamic development, it offers a true record of China's urban growth that values what lies both above and below ground.

programs.title: Yangtze: The River of Life Ep.2
programs.desc: This documentary reveals the current ecological state of the Yangtze River basin—including its fish, wildlife, and plant life—while documenting the efforts behind the Yangtze River protection initiative.

programs.title: General Guan Yu Ep.3
programs.desc: This documentary is a unique exploration of the late Eastern Han dynasty general Guan Yu. Through a gaming team's recreation of the Battle of Xiangfan, overseas collections of his porcelain sculptures, and a coming-of-age ceremony at Guandi temple, this episode recounts his military achievements, while describing a man of loyalty, righteousness, courage, and honor—and an enduring spiritual symbol for the Chinese people.
